entities.title: zazz SDK source
entities.summary: Every module of the zazz SDK, flat in one folder apart from the test library in test/: the script API, the launcher protocol with its native and WASM backends, HTTP, JSON, errors and the human command line.
entities.purpose: Holds the code a script links and the protocol code its launchers share. lib.rs declares the modules and serve; handlers.rs and call.rs are what a script's code touches; proto.rs, native.rs, fdpass.rs and wasm.rs carry calls in and results out; http.rs, json.rs and error.rs are the values passed; cliargs.rs and render.rs serve human callers.
boundaries: std only, and every file must compile with plain rustc: zazzled embeds this folder's files by name (macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz/sdk.rs FILES), so adding, renaming or removing a file means changing that list.
native.rs and fdpass.rs compile only on Unix and wasm.rs only on WASM targets.
Native scripts get no network client (call.rs NoHttp); only the WASM backend reaches the network, through the host.
